# Tidings

> A private finance journal from the transaction emails you already receive. Self-hosted, open source, calm by default.

Tidings turns bank transaction alert emails into a calm daily spending record. This is the marketing site; the documentation lives at docs.gettidings.com.

## Docs

- [Documentation index](https://docs.gettidings.com/llms.txt): curated page index for the docs site
- [Full documentation](https://docs.gettidings.com/llms-full.txt): every docs page in one file
- [API reference](https://docs.gettidings.com/openapi.json): OpenAPI schema

## Try it

- [Live demo](https://gettidings.com/demo): the real app with sample data
- [Demo API](https://gettidings.com/demo/api/v1): read-only JSON API over the same sample data
- [Source code](https://github.com/tvhahn/tidings): GitHub repository
